reviews.comment: A really great professor brought in visuals to help students understand. Class is difficult, but he's available to students for help. Definitely a class that needs lots of effort and time put into it, but Pollalis is a great professor, especially for a hard class.

He's a great teacher! He's very passionate and explains the concepts in the best way he possibly can. He gives a ton of partial credit and the homework is very doable. Its a hard class but he does the best with what he can and makes it as enjoyable as possible! Take him you wont regret it!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly just a good genuine guy. I found this course very easy but if you struggled in statics this course will be very difficult. Final is hard but first 2 exams are easy. Dedicate 3 hours a week to this class and you'll get an A it's that simple. Lectures aren't mandatory but I'd recommend going.

Pollalis is the perfect example of a professor who is both smart AND knows how to teach and he teaches very well. Very accessible outside of class, does not grade too harshly, and makes sure you know exactly what is expected of you. If you put in the work, you will get a good grade in his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There's a lot of material so he goes fast but does good examples in class. Records all his lectures. He does a very good job answering questions and helping on hw. He tries to make class fun sometimes and relate back to things from other courses to help explain. He uses the ACI manual which isn't necessary to buy but very helpful on hw

Genuinely an amazing professor. He really is caring and does everything to help you succeed. He uploads the lectures and is very helpful during office hours. The exams were very similar to the homework and very fair. My only complaint is that sometimes he omits some things from the lecture that end up being very important on the homework.

Genuinely the best professor I've ever had. I made an account just to leave this review because I loved his class and teaching style. Tests weren't too bad and he gives you everything you need to succeed in class. All lectures are recorded and completed notes are shared with students.

Great professor, very knowledgable and passionate. Uploaded lectures online in case you missed class and made models to demonstrate material being learned. There were 4 exams but it splits the material up better and the final was non-comprehensive. Steel can be boring but he made it interesting and easy to understand.

Very wonderful professor.  Made me want to come to class to learn.  I really enjoyed statics with him, and my grade (even to keep an A) was never a concern.  Grading criteria was clear and even included helpful feedback for students.

Gives lots of partial credit, makes exams much easier than hw and only tests to make sure you have an idea of what to do. Also is very lenient about needing to take quizzes or exams early. Actually my favorite prof so far

Tests easier than homework assignments. Uploads all notes and completed example problems, but occasionally will have in class assignments that you need to be there for. Homework takes a long time, but the only way to understand statics is by doing problems. Super nice guy, and wants students to succeed.
He gives good lectures and they are recorded, homework is fairly light
